text: This woman was so shameless, she told investors her company made a hundred million dollars.
Theranos. Elizabeth Holmes promised blood tests from a single finger prick, on a machine called Edison.
Investors poured in over seven hundred million dollars. The valuation? Nine billion. Forbes called her the youngest self-made female billionaire in America.
Hit like if you'd have invested too.
The problem? The Wall Street Journal reported the Edison gave inaccurate results, and the company ran its tests on ordinary commercial machines.
Send this to the friend who believes every startup pitch.
Then Theranos voided two years of Edison results.
Follow along. The number always gives them away.
Guilty on four counts. Eleven years and three months in prison.
A hundred million, claimed. A hundred thousand, real.
